name: agent-usage-tray
description: Limites de 5h e semanal de Claude Code, Codex e Antigravity na bandeja do Windows
author: Vinicius Martinez

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outdir=dist && esbuild src/popup.ts --bundle --platform=browser --outfile=dist/popup.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/popup.html','dist/popup.html')"
